catalogEvidence.publisher: Statistische Ämter des Bundes und der Länder
catalogEvidence.documentationCaveat: The June 2026 Destatis manual applies analogously to GENESIS databases, but Regionalstatistik WADL remains authoritative for request parameters. Destatis-specific credentials, new flatfile schema and structureinformation availability are not assumed for Regionalstatistik.

operations.role: Native table metadata supplies the geographic variable code before data request discovery

operations.response: JSON Ident/Status/Parameter/Object.Content containing native semicolon datencsv; optional Structure and TableLayout
Native datencsv text or bounded ZIP containing exactly one CSV member

ownerAccount.default: empty; no account use until explicit written owner approval is code-reviewed
ownerAccount.tokenMode: username header is the Regionalstatistik token; password header is empty
ownerAccount.passwordMode: username and password headers are the owner's Regionalstatistik account

credentials.limitation: ResourceReference never carries credentials or headers. Documented GAST/token header conventions are not assertions that live credentials, requests or quotas work.

transport.requestBounds: Single explicit year from scope.observationWindow; single GE AGS; native metadata-derived variable; compress=false, transpose=false, job=false; no asynchronous source jobs or hidden retries
transport.cursor: Adapter-owned request-reference pagination, not claimed publisher pagination. One reference per call, bound to admitted snapshot hash, full scope and request list.

tables.title: Bevölkerung nach Geschlecht
tables.semantics: Population stock at sole/main residence; sex dimensions remain source-coded. Not the year-end population table.
tables.methodology: From reporting year 2022 population progression is based on Census 15 May 2022; comparability before/after 2016 is limited by method changes.

tables.title: Bevölkerung nach Geschlecht und Altersgruppen
tables.semantics: Source age-group and sex cells are distinct observations; no unobserved totals or denominator completion.

tables.title: Bestand an Wohngebäuden und Wohnungen in Wohn- und Nichtwohngebäuden
tables.semantics: Building/dwelling stock and housing-area measures are not project-specific completions, occupancy, public ownership or impact.

mapping.nativeInputs: Publisher WADL, native metadata/table JSON, native data/table JSON Object.Content, native tablefile datencsv; no normalized observations feed
mapping.tableIdentity: GENESIS-Tabelle preamble and/or corrected Parameter.name; conflicting IDs fail closed
mapping.geography: Explicit native 8-digit code stays GE; matching native 5-digit code stays KR with null town AGS and district subject. No padding or assignment of a district total to each town. Name-only geography requires native corrected Parameter.regionalkey and matching Structure.Rows variable with Selected=1. Uncoded multi-region rows remain held.
mapping.referenceDate: Exact source date must agree with catalog day. Year-only fields map via catalog table-specific reference day. RetrievedAt is never publication or reference date.
mapping.publicationDate: Unknown/null, never borrowed from retrieval or table Stand timestamp
mapping.nativeDimensions: Front columns and column headers stay in native observation identity, rowKey and exact source-cell evidence. TableLayout.FrontColumnsNumber is used where provided; bare datencsv requires explicit code+label front columns.
mapping.numericCells: German decimal comma parsed without unit scaling; source lexeme retained. Anzahl, %, m², qm and 1000 m² unit labels are recognized only when explicit in native cells.
mapping.quality: Missing/suppressed/non-applicable '.', '...', '/', 'x', 'X' and empty remain null with original sign. '-' alone is the statistical exact-zero sign. Unrecognized quality encodings hold the entire slice; no suppression recovery by subtraction.
mapping.structuredEvidence: Original admitted bytes hash, archive member where applicable, decoded native CSV row/column coordinates (also for JSON Object.Content), raw values, header/front evidence, mapping/schema hash. No invented quotations, LLM or judge receipts.
mapping.coverage: Successful nonempty slice is partial. A terminated recognized empty slice is empty, not universal absence. Native no-objects/error responses are held_quality or blocked_access, not withdrawal/tombstones. No parser result reports complete.
semanticProhibitions: town values derived from district totals

bounds.zipSafety: Shared readZip CRC/member/ratio/path/type/encryption validation; ambiguous multiple CSV members held

rights.admission: No fetched data distribution has been admitted by this implementation. Caller must supply an admitted byte-bound policy receipt; dataset exceptions and geobasis terms remain separate.
rights.publicOutput: Attributed facts only; no implied republication grant for whole snapshots

observed: Regionalstatistik WADL methods/default GAST headers inspected
Regio-Stat 2026 table geography and period definitions inspected
unverified: real publisher payload layouts for these three tables
limitations: No operational-adapter or source-completeness credit until admitted publisher snapshots are actually exercised
Other CSV/flatfile schema versions, XLSX, GENML, opaque name-only tablefile geography and unknown quality markers are held rather than guessed
Shared acquisition must set real identification, host lanes, policy and GAST headers
No causal or civic stage conclusions from statistics

changelog.change: Added deterministic native snapshot adapter and unexecuted fixture suite; documented GAST remains unexercised and all nine-town coverage remains not_checked.
